answer: Reputation must accrete like a river depositing sediment: each epoch an agent banks one unit of stake-anchored trust, but deposits stay unspendable until seasoned across many consecutive epochs. A sybil gains nothing by multiplying, since every identity starts at depth zero and must anchor identical capital and wait identical seasoning for each clone. Bootstrapping N sybils costs N times the locked marble escrow plus N uninterrupted epochs of exposure, and slashing one deposit collapses the forked lineage once timing or nonce patterns link them.
